audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Divine hiddenness, predatory power, poor and vulnerable people, violence, and justice.

verses.restored: Why standest thou afar off, O YHWH? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

familiar.text: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

notes.title: Psalm 9–10 acrostic relationship
notes.body: Psalm 10 continues patterns begun in Psalm 9 and is joined to it in some ancient traditions. The project preserves received Hebrew/KJV chapter numbering while flagging the literary relationship.

modern.text: Why, O LORD, do You stand far off? Why do You hide in times of trouble?

original.text: לָמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תַּעֲמֹ֣ד בְּרָח֑וֹק תַּ֝עְלִ֗ים לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה

verses.restored: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

familiar.text: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

modern.text: In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise.

original.text: בְּגַאֲוַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע יִדְלַ֣ק עָנִ֑י יִתָּפְשׂ֓וּ בִּמְזִמּ֖וֹת ז֣וּ חָשָֽׁבוּ

verses.restored: For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the YHWH abhorreth.

familiar.text: For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the LORD abhorreth.

modern.text: For the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.

original.text: כִּֽי הִלֵּ֣ל רָ֭שָׁע עַל תַּאֲוַ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּבֹצֵ֥עַ בֵּ֝רֵ֗ךְ נִ֘אֵ֥ץ יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.

familiar.text: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.

modern.text: In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him; in all his schemes there is no God.

original.text: רָשָׁ֗ע כְּגֹ֣בַהּ אַ֭פּוֹ בַּל יִדְרֹ֑שׁ אֵ֥ין אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים כָּל מְזִמּוֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

familiar.text: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

modern.text: He is secure in his ways at all times; Your lofty judgments are far from him; he sneers at all his foes.

original.text: יָ֘חִ֤ילוּ דרכו בְּכָל עֵ֗ת מָר֣וֹם מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ מִנֶּגְדּ֑וֹ כָּל צ֝וֹרְרָ֗יו יָפִ֥יחַ בָּהֶֽם

verses.restored: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.

familiar.text: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.

modern.text: He says to himself, “I will not be moved; from age to age I am free of distress.”

original.text: אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ בַּל אֶמּ֑וֹט לְדֹ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא בְרָֽע

verses.restored: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

familiar.text: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

modern.text: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.

original.text: אָלָ֤ה פִּ֣יהוּ מָ֭לֵא וּמִרְמ֣וֹת וָתֹ֑ךְ תַּ֥חַת לְ֝שׁוֹנ֗וֹ עָמָ֥ל וָאָֽוֶן

verses.restored: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

familiar.text: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

modern.text: He lies in wait near the villages; in ambush he slays the innocent; his eyes watch in stealth for the helpless.

original.text: יֵשֵׁ֤ב בְּמַאְרַ֬ב חֲצֵרִ֗ים בַּֽ֭מִּסְתָּרִים יַהֲרֹ֣ג נָקִ֑י עֵ֝ינָ֗יו לְֽחֵלְכָ֥ה יִצְפֹּֽנוּ

verses.restored: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

familiar.text: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

modern.text: He lies in wait like a lion in a thicket; he lurks to seize the oppressed; he catches the lowly in his net.

original.text: יֶאֱרֹ֬ב בַּמִּסְתָּ֨ר כְּאַרְיֵ֬ה בְסֻכֹּ֗ה יֶ֭אֱרֹב לַחֲט֣וֹף עָנִ֑י יַחְטֹ֥ף עָ֝נִ֗י בְּמָשְׁכ֥וֹ בְרִשְׁתּֽוֹ

verses.restored: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

familiar.text: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

modern.text: They are crushed and beaten down; the hapless fall prey to his strength.

verses.restored: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.

familiar.text: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.

modern.text: He says to himself, “God has forgotten; He hides His face and never sees.”

original.text: אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ שָׁ֣כַֽח אֵ֑ל הִסְתִּ֥יר פָּ֝נָ֗יו בַּל רָאָ֥ה לָנֶֽצַח

verses.restored: Arise, O YHWH; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

familiar.text: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

modern.text: Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.

original.text: קוּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֭ל נְשָׂ֣א יָדֶ֑ךָ אַל תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח עניים

verses.restored: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.

familiar.text: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.

modern.text: Why has the wicked man renounced God? He says to himself, “You will never call me to account.”

original.text: עַל מֶ֤ה נִאֵ֖ץ רָשָׁ֥ע אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָמַ֥ר בְּ֝לִבּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א תִּדְרֹֽשׁ

verses.restored: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.

familiar.text: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.

modern.text: But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.

original.text: רָאִ֡תָה כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה עָ֘מָ֤ל וָכַ֨עַס תַּבִּיט֮ לָתֵ֪ת בְּיָ֫דֶ֥ךָ עָ֭לֶיךָ יַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵלֶ֑כָה יָ֝ת֗וֹם אַתָּ֤ה הָיִ֬יתָ עוֹזֵֽר

verses.restored: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

familiar.text: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

modern.text: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found.

original.text: שְׁ֭בֹר זְר֣וֹעַ רָשָׁ֑ע וָ֝רָ֗ע תִּֽדְרוֹשׁ רִשְׁע֥וֹ בַל תִּמְצָֽא

verses.restored: The YHWH is King for ever and ever: the nations are perished out of his land.

familiar.text: The LORD is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

modern.text: The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.

original.text: יְהוָ֣ה מֶ֭לֶךְ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד אָבְד֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם מֵֽאַרְצֽוֹ

verses.restored: YHWH, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:

familiar.text: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:

modern.text: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their hearts. You will incline Your ear,

original.text: תַּאֲוַ֬ת עֲנָוִ֣ים שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ יְהוָ֑ה תָּכִ֥ין לִ֝בָּ֗ם תַּקְשִׁ֥יב אָזְנֶֽךָ

verses.restored: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

familiar.text: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

modern.text: to vindicate the fatherless and oppressed, that the men of the earth may strike terror no more.

original.text: לִשְׁפֹּ֥ט יָת֗וֹם וָ֫דָ֥ךְ בַּל יוֹסִ֥יף ע֑וֹד לַעֲרֹ֥ץ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ מִן הָאָֽרֶץ

translation_notes: This chapter expands corpus coverage while remaining explicitly pending a deeper Hebrew/source-witness audit. KJV is retained only as the familiar comparison layer.

The completion draft intentionally preserves coherent traditional English syntax where a verse has not yet received a curated Hebrew-sensitive rendering; it does not mix archaic and modern grammar. Major identified lexical/textual issues receive explicit overrides and notes.
safety_note: The psalm describes predatory abuse of the poor; it should strengthen protection of vulnerable people, not stigmatize poverty.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Scrolls where extant, and other relevant witnesses during the global audit.
Audit Psalms 9–10 together for alphabetic-acrostic structure and numbering differences across traditions.
